limits: One underlying gate task; cosmetic domain names and correlated variants do not form independent benchmark environments.
Simulation actors scripted; symbolic gate success does not establish real-world collusion capability.
Next-token normalized scores are uncalibrated; thresholds selected on calibration only.
Random seed runs are evaluated separately, then metrics averaged; no free ensemble of disclosures.
Arbiter conditions are not adjudicated malicious behavior or execution success.
Evidence sufficiency is curator-defined, not independently adjudicated.
Exploratory multiple comparisons; a positive isolated cell does not validate the hypothesis.
Follow-up on the same underlying toy task; diagnostic ablations, not independent confirmation.
